column2:
tablet(n.)平板電腦、藥片、碑
(無詞性變化)
tablet computer 平板電腦
take a tablet 吃一顆藥
Many students take notes on their tablets.
(許多學生用平板電腦做筆記。)
Take two tablets after each meal.
(每餐飯後服用兩顆藥片。)

tag(n./v.)標籤、貼標籤、標記
(無詞性變化)
price tag 價格標籤
name tag 名牌
Don't forget to remove the price tag from the gift.
(別忘了把禮物上的價格標籤撕掉。)
She tagged her friends in the photo.
(她在照片中標記了她的朋友。)

tailor(n.)裁縫師
tailored(adj.)量身訂做的
tailor-made 量身訂做的
local tailor 當地裁縫師
The tailor made a suit for my father.
(裁縫師為我爸爸做了一套西裝。)
The program is tailor-made for beginners.
(這個課程是專為初學者量身打造的。)

talent(n.)天分、才能、人才
talented(adj.)有天分的
talent show 才藝表演
a talent for 有……的天分
She has a real talent for music.
(她在音樂方面很有天分。)
Our class won first prize in the talent show.
(我們班在才藝表演中得到第一名。)

talkative(adj.)健談的、多話的
talk(v.)說話
talkative person 多話的人
become talkative 變得話多
My little brother is very talkative at dinner.
(我弟弟吃晚餐時話很多。)
She is shy at first but becomes talkative later.
(她一開始很害羞，但後來就變得很健談。)

tame(adj./v.)溫馴的、馴服
(無詞性變化)
tame animal 溫馴的動物
tame a horse 馴服一匹馬
The deer in Nara are so tame that you can feed them.
(奈良的鹿非常溫馴，你可以餵牠們。)
It took him months to tame the wild horse.
(他花了好幾個月才馴服那匹野馬。)

tangerine(n.)橘子、柑橘
(無詞性變化)
peel a tangerine 剝橘子
tangerine juice 橘子汁
People give tangerines as gifts during Chinese New Year.
(人們在農曆新年送橘子當禮物。)
She peeled a tangerine and shared it with me.
(她剝了一顆橘子和我分享。)

tank(n.)槽、箱、坦克
(無詞性變化)
fish tank 魚缸
gas tank 油箱
There are five goldfish in the fish tank.
(魚缸裡有五隻金魚。)
We need to fill up the gas tank before the trip.
(出發前我們需要把油箱加滿。)

tap(v./n.)輕拍、輕敲、水龍頭
(無詞性變化)
tap water 自來水
tap on the shoulder 輕拍肩膀
Someone tapped me on the shoulder on the bus.
(在公車上有人輕拍我的肩膀。)
Tap the screen twice to open the app.
(在螢幕上點兩下打開這個應用程式。)

tasty(adj.)美味的、可口的
taste(n./v.)味道、品嘗
tasteful(adj.)有品味的
tasty food 美味的食物
tasty snack 好吃的點心
The night market has lots of tasty snacks.
(夜市裡有很多好吃的小吃。)
This soup is healthy and tasty.
(這碗湯既健康又美味。)

tease(v.)取笑、捉弄
teasing(n.)取笑、戲弄
tease someone about 拿……取笑某人
just teasing 只是開玩笑
Stop teasing your sister about her haircut.
(別再拿你妹妹的髮型取笑她了。)
Don't be angry. I was just teasing you.
(別生氣，我只是在逗你。)

technical(adj.)技術的、專門的
technique(n.)技巧
technically(adv.)技術上、嚴格來說
technical problem 技術問題
technical school 技術學校
The concert was delayed because of a technical problem.
(演唱會因為技術問題而延遲。)
The article has too many technical terms.
(這篇文章有太多專業術語。)

technique(n.)技巧、技術、手法
technical(adj.)技術的
learning technique 學習技巧
develop a technique 發展技巧
She uses a special technique to remember new words.
(她用一種特別的技巧記新單字。)
The coach taught us a new swimming technique.
(教練教我們一種新的游泳技巧。)

teenage(adj.)十幾歲的、青少年的
teenager(n.)青少年
teen(n.)青少年
teenage years 青少年時期
teenage girl 十幾歲的女孩
Many teenage students spend hours on their phones.
(許多青少年學生花好幾個小時在手機上。)
He enjoyed his teenage years in Tainan.
(他在台南度過了愉快的青少年時期。)

temper(n.)脾氣、情緒
temperament(n.)性情、氣質
lose one's temper 發脾氣
bad temper 壞脾氣
My dad never loses his temper with us.
(我爸爸從來不對我們發脾氣。)
He has a bad temper when he is hungry.
(他肚子餓時脾氣很差。)

temporary(adj.)暫時的、臨時的
temporarily(adv.)暫時地
temporary job 臨時工作
temporary solution 權宜之計
She found a temporary job during summer vacation.
(她在暑假找到一份臨時工作。)
The road is temporarily closed for repairs.
(這條路因整修暫時封閉。)

tend(v.)傾向、往往會、照料
tendency(n.)傾向、趨勢
tend to 往往、傾向於
tend to the sick 照顧病人
I tend to feel sleepy after lunch.
(我午餐後往往會覺得想睡。)
Nurses tend to patients day and night.
(護理師日夜照顧病人。)

tender(adj.)嫩的、溫柔的、疼痛的
tenderness(n.)溫柔、柔軟
tenderly(adv.)溫柔地
tender meat 嫩肉
tender care 細心照顧
The steak was tender and juicy.
(這塊牛排又嫩又多汁。)
She spoke to the child in a tender voice.
(她用溫柔的聲音對孩子說話。)

tent(n.)帳篷
(無詞性變化)
put up a tent 搭帳篷
camping tent 露營帳篷
We put up our tent near the lake.
(我們在湖邊搭起帳篷。)
It rained all night, but we stayed dry in the tent.
(雨下了一整晚，但我們在帳篷裡很乾爽。)

terrific(adj.)極好的、了不起的、極大的
terrifically(adv.)極其
terrific job 做得太棒了
terrific idea 絕佳的主意
You did a terrific job on the project.
(你這個專題做得太棒了。)
We had a terrific time at the beach.
(我們在海邊玩得很開心。)

territory(n.)領土、領域、地盤
territorial(adj.)領土的
enemy territory 敵方領土
new territory 新領域
Some animals mark their territory with smells.
(有些動物會用氣味標記地盤。)
For me, cooking is new territory.
(對我來說，烹飪是個全新的領域。)

thankful(adj.)感謝的、慶幸的
thank(v.)感謝
thankfully(adv.)幸好、感激地
thankful for 對……感激
be thankful that 慶幸……
I am thankful for my parents' support.
(我很感謝父母的支持。)
We were thankful that no one was hurt.
(我們很慶幸沒有人受傷。)

theory(n.)理論、學說
theoretical(adj.)理論上的
in theory 理論上
theory of evolution 演化論
In theory, the plan should work.
(理論上，這個計畫應該行得通。)
Darwin is famous for his theory of evolution.
(達爾文因他的演化論而聞名。)

thirst(n.)口渴、渴望
thirsty(adj.)口渴的
quench one's thirst 解渴
thirst for knowledge 求知慾
A glass of cold water will quench your thirst.
(一杯冰水就能幫你解渴。)
She has a strong thirst for knowledge.
(她有強烈的求知慾。)

thread(n./v.)線、思路、穿線
(無詞性變化)
needle and thread 針線
lose the thread 失去思路
Grandma threaded the needle without glasses.
(奶奶不戴眼鏡就把針穿上了線。)
I lost the thread of the story halfway through.
(故事聽到一半我就跟不上了。)

threat(n.)威脅、恐嚇
threaten(v.)威脅
threatening(adj.)威脅的
serious threat 嚴重威脅
a threat to …的威脅
Plastic waste is a serious threat to sea life.
(塑膠垃圾對海洋生物是嚴重的威脅。)
He ignored the threat and kept walking.
(他不理會威脅，繼續往前走。)

threaten(v.)威脅、恐嚇、可能危及
threat(n.)威脅
threatened(adj.)受威脅的
threaten to 揚言要
threaten one's life 危及生命
The man threatened to call the police.
(那個男人揚言要報警。)
Climate change threatens many animals.
(氣候變遷威脅著許多動物。)

thumb(n./v.)拇指、用拇指翻
(無詞性變化)
thumbs up 讚、豎起大拇指
thumb through 快速翻閱
He gave me a thumbs up after my speech.
(我演講完後他對我豎起大拇指。)
She thumbed through the magazine while waiting.
(她在等待時隨手翻閱雜誌。)

tide(n.)潮汐、潮流
tidal(adj.)潮汐的
high tide 漲潮
low tide 退潮
You can find crabs on the beach at low tide.
(退潮時你可以在海灘上找到螃蟹。)
The tide is coming in, so let's go back.
(開始漲潮了，我們回去吧。)

tight(adj./adv.)緊的、緊密的、緊緊地
tightly(adv.)緊緊地
tighten(v.)拉緊
tight schedule 緊湊的行程
hold tight 抓緊
These jeans are too tight for me.
(這條牛仔褲對我來說太緊了。)
Hold tight, or you'll fall off.
(抓緊，不然你會掉下去。)

tighten(v.)拉緊、加強、收緊
tight(adj.)緊的
tighten one's belt 勒緊褲帶、節省開支
tighten security 加強安全措施
Please tighten your seat belt.
(請繫緊你的安全帶。)
The airport tightened security after the incident.
(事件發生後，機場加強了安檢。)

timber(n.)木材、木料
(無詞性變化)
timber house 木屋
timber industry 木材業
The old house was built of timber.
(這棟老房子是用木材建造的。)
Taiwan once had a large timber industry.
(台灣過去曾有龐大的木材業。)

tobacco(n.)菸草、菸
(無詞性變化)
tobacco smoke 菸草煙霧
tobacco company 菸草公司
Tobacco is harmful to your health.
(菸草對你的健康有害。)
Selling tobacco to teenagers is against the law.
(賣菸給青少年是違法的。)

ton(n.)噸、大量
(無詞性變化)
tons of 大量的
weigh a ton 很重
This truck can carry ten tons of sand.
(這輛卡車可以載十噸的沙。)
I have tons of homework this weekend.
(我這個週末有一大堆功課。)

toss(v./n.)扔、拋、擲硬幣
(無詞性變化)
toss a coin 擲硬幣
toss and turn 輾轉反側
Let's toss a coin to decide who goes first.
(我們擲硬幣決定誰先開始吧。)
I tossed and turned all night before the exam.
(考試前一晚我整夜輾轉難眠。)

tough(adj.)困難的、堅強的、(肉)老的
toughness(n.)堅韌
toughen(v.)使堅強
tough decision 艱難的決定
tough guy 硬漢
It was a tough decision to leave my hometown.
(離開家鄉是個艱難的決定。)
This meat is too tough to chew.
(這塊肉太老了，咬不動。)

tourism(n.)觀光業、旅遊業
tour(n./v.)旅行
tourist(n.)觀光客
tourism industry 觀光產業
eco-tourism 生態旅遊
Tourism is important to Hualien's economy.
(觀光業對花蓮的經濟很重要。)
The government is trying to promote tourism.
(政府正努力推廣觀光。)

tourist(n.)觀光客、遊客
tour(n./v.)旅行
tourism(n.)觀光業
tourist attraction 觀光景點
foreign tourist 外國遊客
Taipei 101 is a popular tourist attraction.
(台北101是熱門的觀光景點。)
Many foreign tourists visit the night markets.
(許多外國遊客造訪夜市。)

tow(n./v.)拖、拖吊
(無詞性變化)
tow truck 拖吊車
be towed away 被拖吊
My car was towed away because I parked illegally.
(我的車因為違規停車被拖吊了。)
We called a tow truck after the accident.
(車禍後我們叫了拖吊車。)

tower(n.)塔、高樓
towering(adj.)高聳的
clock tower 鐘樓
water tower 水塔
The Eiffel Tower is a symbol of Paris.
(艾菲爾鐵塔是巴黎的象徵。)
There is an old clock tower in the center of town.
(鎮中心有一座古老的鐘樓。)

trace(n./v.)痕跡、追蹤、描摹
(無詞性變化)
without a trace 無影無蹤
trace back to 追溯到
The thief disappeared without a trace.
(小偷消失得無影無蹤。)
This custom can be traced back to the Qing Dynasty.
(這個習俗可以追溯到清朝。)

trader(n.)商人、交易者
trade(n./v.)貿易、交易
stock trader 股票交易員
fur trader 毛皮商
The Dutch traders came to Taiwan in the 17th century.
(荷蘭商人在十七世紀來到台灣。)
My uncle works as a stock trader.
(我叔叔是一名股票交易員。)

trail(n./v.)小徑、蹤跡、拖曳、落後
trailer(n.)預告片、拖車
hiking trail 登山步道
trail behind 落後
We followed the hiking trail up the mountain.
(我們沿著登山步道上山。)
Our team was trailing by ten points at halftime.
(我們隊在中場時落後十分。)

transport(n./v.)運輸、交通工具、運送
transportation(n.)交通運輸
public transport 大眾運輸
transport goods 運送貨物
Public transport in Taipei is very convenient.
(台北的大眾運輸非常方便。)
Trucks transport fruit from the farms to the markets.
(卡車把水果從農場運送到市場。)

traveler(n.)旅行者、旅客
travel(v./n.)旅行
solo traveler 獨自旅行者
business traveler 商務旅客
More and more young travelers like to travel alone.
(越來越多年輕旅客喜歡獨自旅行。)
The hotel offers free breakfast to all travelers.
(這家飯店為所有旅客提供免費早餐。)

tray(n.)托盤、盤子
(無詞性變化)
ice tray 製冰盒
food tray 餐盤
The waiter carried drinks on a tray.
(服務生用托盤端飲料。)
Please return your food tray after eating.
(用餐後請歸還你的餐盤。)

trend(n.)趨勢、潮流
trendy(adj.)時髦的
fashion trend 流行趨勢
follow the trend 跟隨潮流
She always follows the latest fashion trends.
(她總是跟隨最新的流行趨勢。)
There is a growing trend of working from home.
(在家工作的趨勢越來越明顯。)

tribe(n.)部落、種族
tribal(adj.)部落的
tribe member 部落成員
indigenous tribe 原住民部落
We visited an Amis tribe in Hualien.
(我們拜訪了花蓮的一個阿美族部落。)
Each tribe has its own language and culture.
(每個部落都有自己的語言和文化。)

tricky(adj.)棘手的、狡猾的
trick(n./v.)詭計、欺騙
tricky question 棘手的問題
tricky situation 棘手的情況
That was a tricky question on the test.
(那是考試中一道很刁鑽的題目。)
Driving in heavy rain can be tricky.
(在大雨中開車可能很棘手。)

troop(n.)(複數)部隊、軍隊、一群
trooper(n.)騎兵、州警
send troops 派遣部隊
a troop of 一群
The government sent troops to help after the earthquake.
(地震後政府派遣部隊協助救災。)
A troop of monkeys came down from the mountain.
(一群猴子從山上下來。)

tropical(adj.)熱帶的
tropics(n.)熱帶地區
tropical fruit 熱帶水果
tropical rainforest 熱帶雨林
Mangoes and papayas are tropical fruits.
(芒果和木瓜都是熱帶水果。)
Southern Taiwan has a tropical climate.
(台灣南部屬於熱帶氣候。)

trumpet(n.)喇叭、小號
trumpeter(n.)小號手
play the trumpet 吹小號
blow one's own trumpet 自吹自擂
He plays the trumpet in the school band.
(他在學校樂隊吹小號。)
She never blows her own trumpet.
(她從不自吹自擂。)

trunk(n.)樹幹、象鼻、汽車後車廂
(無詞性變化)
tree trunk 樹幹
car trunk 後車廂
Put the suitcases in the trunk of the car.
(把行李箱放進汽車後車廂。)
An elephant uses its trunk to drink water.
(大象用鼻子喝水。)

truthful(adj.)誠實的、真實的
truth(n.)事實、真相
truthfully(adv.)誠實地
truthful answer 誠實的回答
be truthful with 對……誠實
Please give me a truthful answer.
(請給我一個誠實的回答。)
You should always be truthful with your friends.
(你應該永遠對朋友誠實。)

tub(n.)浴缸、桶、盆
bathtub(n.)浴缸
hot tub 熱水浴缸
a tub of ice cream 一桶冰淇淋
The baby is playing in the tub.
(寶寶在浴缸裡玩。)
He ate a whole tub of ice cream by himself.
(他自己吃完了一整桶冰淇淋。)

tug(n./v.)用力拉、拖
(無詞性變化)
tug of war 拔河
tug at 拉扯
Our class won the tug of war on sports day.
(我們班在運動會拔河比賽中獲勝。)
The child tugged at his mother's sleeve.
(那孩子拉了拉媽媽的袖子。)

tune(n./v.)曲調、調音、調整頻道
(無詞性變化)
in tune 音準的、協調的
stay tuned 敬請鎖定
She is humming a happy tune.
(她正在哼一首快樂的曲子。)
Stay tuned for more news after the break.
(廣告後更多新聞，敬請鎖定。)

tunnel(n./v.)隧道、挖隧道
(無詞性變化)
go through a tunnel 穿過隧道
light at the end of the tunnel 苦盡甘來的曙光
It takes about ten minutes to drive through the Hsuehshan Tunnel.
(開車通過雪山隧道大約要十分鐘。)
After months of hard work, we finally see light at the end of the tunnel.
(經過幾個月的努力，我們終於看見了曙光。)

tutor(n./v.)家教、導師、個別指導
tutorial(n./adj.)教學課程、輔導的
private tutor 私人家教
math tutor 數學家教
My parents hired a math tutor for me.
(我爸媽幫我請了一位數學家教。)
She tutors high school students in English.
(她為高中生做英文家教。)

twin(n.)雙胞胎之一
(無詞性變化)
twin brother 雙胞胎兄弟
identical twins 同卵雙胞胎
Tom and his twin brother look exactly alike.
(湯姆和他的雙胞胎兄弟長得一模一樣。)
It's hard to tell the identical twins apart.
(很難分辨這對同卵雙胞胎。)

twist(n./v.)扭轉、扭傷、意外轉折
twisted(adj.)扭曲的
twist one's ankle 扭傷腳踝
plot twist 劇情轉折
I twisted my ankle while playing basketball.
(我打籃球時扭傷了腳踝。)
The movie has a surprising plot twist at the end.
(這部電影結尾有個出人意料的劇情轉折。)

underlying(v.)作為……的基礎(underlie 的現在分詞)、潛在的、根本的
underlie(v.)構成……的基礎
underlying cause 根本原因
underlying problem 潛在的問題
We need to find the underlying cause of the problem.
(我們必須找出這個問題的根本原因。)
Stress was the underlying reason for his poor sleep.
(壓力是他睡不好的根本原因。)

underwear(n.)內衣褲
(無詞性變化)
clean underwear 乾淨的內衣褲
thermal underwear 保暖內衣
Pack enough underwear for the five-day trip.
(五天的旅行要帶足夠的內衣褲。)
